svg.title: Slope field of dC/dt equals 8 e to the minus t minus C, for t and C from 0 to 4. A dashed curve C equals 8 e to the minus t falls from the top left towards the t-axis. The solution curve starts at the origin, rises steeply, reaches a maximum where it meets the dashed curve at about t equals 1 and C equals 2.94, then falls slowly towards the t-axis.
